description: PC(A, B) has primary key (A, B) with rows (1,1) and (1,2); CC(ID, X, Y) is related by one two-field relation PC.A to CC.X and PC.B to CC.Y. Which of these inserts into CC (dbFailOnError) does ACE accept: (1,1), (1,3), (Null,1), (1,Null), (Null,Null), (2,1), (1,2)? Errors after each, then the rows of CC.
